authority.parity_rule: Do not infer intended behavior from field names. Match the source-defined live behavior unless an ambiguity below is explicitly resolved and versioned.

fields.canonicalization: bool/uint8; false suppresses observable cue values while preserving internal prior-cue causal state
effective only with patch_world_observation_enable and effective WDL enable
declared but has no live Python consumer
false means no event scheduling; there is no stochastic fallback

config.native_validation_difference: The native header API validates already-canonical values and rejects out-of-range values. The live Python step clamps/coerces its numeric mechanics inputs. Callers must canonicalize before native validation if Python parity is required.

state.layout: seven C-contiguous structure-of-arrays fields, each shaped [height,width]; native view is flattened row-major with cell_count=height*width

fields.name: patch_delayed_hazard_cue
fields.update: cleared each enabled step; set to 1 for cue_mask and newly scheduled cells
fields.continuation: restore exact array before next step
fields.failure: missing or wrong shape raises in Python access/validation
fields.cancel: no write when native cancellation is accepted before advance_tick

fields.name: patch_delayed_hazard_timer
fields.update: occupied iff timer>=0; decrement occupied cells; new schedule writes delay_steps+active_duration_steps; done writes -1
fields.failure: values below -1 invalid in native checkpoint

fields.name: patch_delayed_hazard_active
fields.update: cleared each step; 1 where occupied and delay<=age<delay+active_duration

fields.name: patch_delayed_hazard_intensity
fields.update: new schedule writes configured intensity even before active; active rewrites it; cells outside cue/hidden/active write 0

fields.name: patch_delayed_hazard_age
fields.update: increment occupied cells; new schedule and done write 0

fields.name: patch_delayed_hazard_event_id
fields.update: all newly scheduled cells receive the same SHA256-derived positive 63-bit event id; done writes 0

fields.name: patch_delayed_hazard_prior_cue
fields.update: set 1 in cue/hidden/active and on schedule; done writes 0

state.initialization: initialize_patch_world_arrays adds WDL arrays only under effective enable; initialize_patch_world_runtime_fields resets per-tick counters
state.environment_reset: GridWorld reset recreates all seven arrays from defaults and resets runtime counters
state.generation_reset: runner_generation resets WDL generation accumulators, event contexts, damaged-id set, and generation-persistent cued-agent set

schedule.footprint: axis-aligned square [y-radius,y+radius] x [x-radius,x+radius], clipped to grid; not a Euclidean circle
schedule.collision_rule: schedule only cells whose timer<0; a logical event may schedule a partial footprint or zero cells
schedule.event_count_semantics: count of newly scheduled cells, not count of logical event ids
schedule.base_seed_fallback: Normal GridWorld stores base_seed. If absent, live Python hashes the stringified RNG bit-generator state with process-salted Python hash; this fallback is not guaranteed cross-process deterministic.

dropout.input: clip cue to [0,1] and replace non-finite values with 0
dropout.formula: mixed=(y*1103515245 + x*12345 + (base_seed & 0xffffffff) + 0x9e3779b9) & 0xffffffff; unit=mixed/2^32; keep=unit>=dropout; output=cue if keep else 0
dropout.temporal_semantics: mask is fixed per cell and base seed because abs_step and event_id are not salted into the formula

order_within_wdl_step: return zero metrics if effective WDL disabled
age++ and timer-- for occupied cells
derive cue, hidden, active, and done masks from occupied and updated age
accumulate active-cell delay metrics and activated ids
schedule current absolute-step event into timer<0 cells
compute final cell-count and integrity metrics
phase_contract.new_event_state: cue=1, timer=delay, active=0, intensity=config intensity, age=0, event_id=derived id, prior_cue=1
exact_simulation_tick_order: check graceful-stop flag before authoritative tick work
inside patch_world_step: WDL, prediction demand, delayed resource, delayed waste, MEM-MAX, trace, food
spawn food and other pre-policy environment work
build alive list, canonical sort, then runner RNG shuffle
policy observes current WDL cue channel and selects actions
record passive pre-environment WDL action context
apply normal environment tick including movement
apply WDL damage using post-action positions against the pre-policy active map
apply MEM-MAX consequence and remaining internal-state/reproduction phases
phase_contract.damage_order: iterate alive environment ids in ascending numeric order; skip invalid positions/non-active cells/missing-dead population agents; apply optional shared PATH1 refuge adjustment; subtract bounded effective damage; update metrics/context; remove agent on health<=0

observation_schema.channel_order: after legacy food/occupancy and the seven base Patch World normalized maps; WDL is local channel index 8 when no earlier optional extension changes the base set
observation_schema.local_layout: zero-padded [2*view_radius+1]^2 window; channel-major stack flattened to float32

cell_schedule_event.activated_ids: sorted unique positive ids present in active cells each active tick

event_schema.damage_context: one sampled patch context per damaging agent exposure with wdl_damage and PATH1 adjustment fields; context sampling failure is swallowed

chronicle_event.emission: generation-level candidate when generation event_count>0 and chronicle persistence condition is ready
chronicle_event.failure_policy: chronicle is observability-only and exceptions do not interrupt mechanics

semantics.cue_without_active_count: prior_cue>0 && active<=0, including visible-cue and hidden cells
semantics.cue_to_active_delay_sum_and_count: delay is accumulated once per active cell per active tick, not only on transition

aggregation.cue_and_active_cell_count: sum per tick divided by WDL tick count
aggregation.agents_damaged: unique damaged agent ids during generation
aggregation.agent_cue_exposure_count: repeated cue exposure rows, not unique agents
aggregation.cued_history: agent-id set persists for the full generation and is not cleared per event
aggregation.lineage_hazard_exposure: 1.0 for each lineage having a damage context

python_order: world base arrays and environment RNG state
Patch World base arrays and pending arrays
WDL schema version and all seven arrays in state descriptor order
RNG restore and remaining runner/population state according to bundle-v2 apply order
restore_order: merge WDL arrays into Patch World validation input
validate shape and coerce exact dtypes
initialize runtime fields, which resets per-tick counters
restore runner generation counters, contexts, and damaged-id set

native_binary_layout.restore_atomicity: validate complete header and serialized state before first destination state write

continuation.generation_boundary: all seven arrays continue exactly; per-generation counters/history reset by the next generation
continuation.not_checkpointed: _wdl_agents_cued_current_gen is not explicitly in bundle-v2 state; normal generation-boundary continuation makes this consistent with its generation reset

failure_and_cancel_contract.python_step_failure: config/array/mechanics exceptions propagate from patch_world_step; no partial-write rollback
failure_and_cancel_contract.python_damage_failure: WDL/PATH1 import failure returns without damage; patch context failures are swallowed; resident scalar sync failure rethrows only under configured fail-closed mode
failure_and_cancel_contract.native_cancel: advance_tick and apply_delayed_damage validate output pointers, then return cancelled before state, schedule, health, alive, or output-metric writes
failure_and_cancel_contract.graceful_stop: first SIGINT/SIGTERM sets stop flag; tick loop checks it before Patch World work; second SIGINT exits immediately
failure_and_cancel_contract.graceful_checkpoint: after early tick-loop exit, runner closes the generation and writes a bundle labeled for generation+1
failure_and_cancel_contract.cancel_ambiguity: A mid-generation graceful stop skips remaining ticks but advances the checkpoint generation, so continuation skips their absolute-step WDL phases rather than resuming the interrupted tick.
failure_and_cancel_contract.ordinary_exception: run status is marked failed and exception is re-raised; there is no automatic failure checkpoint

known_ambiguities.live_behavior: event_count counts scheduled cells; cue exposure counts repeated action rows; delay count counts active cell-ticks.
known_ambiguities.migration_decision_required: Preserve these aggregation units for parity and describe them explicitly in downstream schemas.

resolved_control_path_repairs.behavior: The live timer retains delay_steps + active_duration_steps and cleanup occurs after exactly active_duration_steps active ticks.
resolved_control_path_repairs.parity: Python, CPU-native, and CUDA contracts use the same schedule.

resolved_control_path_repairs.behavior: cue_enabled now controls scheduled and cue-phase cue visibility while prior-cue state and hazard timing remain deterministic.
resolved_control_path_repairs.parity: Python, CPU-native, and CUDA contracts use the same gate.
